title: Tame symmetric algebras of period four with small Gabriel quivers
summary: The tame symmetric algebras of period four, TSP4 algebras for short, form an important class of algebras, with interesting links to various branches of modern algebra. The study of this class has been recently developed in two major directions. The first embraces new classes of examples of TSP4 algebras, such as virtual mutations and generalized weighted surface algebras, both extending known class of the weighted surface algebras.
